149.hello: "Hello," he says, extending a delicate hand. "I have seen your face before," he says, cocking his head sideways. "What is it you need?"

qa.a: "@Faren." "@Faren the @drunk as some call me." He winks at you.
"Just kidding." He smiles broadly.
"You might have noticed the similarity between my @sister and me."
"A beautiful lass @Stephanie is."
"Have you met her? Then you know she is @blind."
"Yes, has been so since birth." "For her it is like being born a @gargoyle."

"She knows no other life. It is her lot to make the best of her situation." "In this she is no different than you or I." He pauses to gather his thoughts. "Even gargoyles face this dilemma, I'll wager." "But we know them more by the ways they differ from us, rather than their similarities."
"I sell many types of @wine, made right here." He clicks his tongue.
"Have a nice $T." He sips his wineglass.
He scratches his head and looks around.
$N glances at $Y, "You look pretty full to me."

150.name: Zeke
150.look: a strong looking man with just one arm.
150.hello: "Hello," he shouts, waving. "You've met @Zeke before, 'aven't ya?" he says, glaring at you. "What d'ya need?"

qa.a: "@Zeke the one-armed @beekeep, it is."
"Lost me arm and gained that name in @battle." He flashes a yellowed grin at you.
"'Twas a horrid affair, but @Mondain had to be thwarted."

"You must be new here." He looks to the ground. "He brought an age of great evil unto our land." "Yet try and tell today's children of the age of darkness..." "They believe nothing can go wrong, as long as the Avatar lives."
"Bees are true friends. They work all day, making honey and scattering pollen." "All we have to do is provide them with @hives." He laughs. "And get stung once in a while!"
"I buys all my hives from a nice lady in Minoc named Michelle." "She weaves them out of straw."
"I'm the @beekeeper here at the abbey." "If you want to @buy @honey, or @sell me a honey jar I'm all ears (if only one-armed)."
"Have a nice $T."
He scratches his head and looks around.
"You look pretty full to me."
"Enjoy your 'oney."

151.name: Eckhart
151.look: a gnarled man with knobby muscles.
151.hello: "Hullo, $G." He touches his cap respectfully. He has a very sharp knife with which he prunes off less productive branches. * "Mind that you stay out of the flight paths of the @bees, $G."

qa.a: "Eckhart the vinekeeper, at your service, ma'am." sir."
You notice the bees have regular aerial routes all about the vineyard. "Zeke keeps bees on the other side of the abbey, $G."
"I care for the @garden and tend the @vines."
"Some of our rosebushes were planted by druids hundreds of years ago." "Eventually, we became the Brotherhood of the Rose."
"These rows," he gestures, "are "Here at the abbey we grow @seedless grapes."
"Amazing, ain't it, $G. The @enchanter made them for us." "Now I grow new vines by grafting seedless @grapevines onto regular rootstocks."
"Yes, $G. He lives east of here, between two rivers." "His hut be due north of Britain, or so they tell me."
"Visit me in the fields some time and I'll give you some!"
"Ask @Faren of that."
"Yes, Faren--the local winemaker."
He waves and turns back to work. Eckhart waves goodbye.
"Beg pardon, $G?"

152.name: Gherick
152.look: a tall man, covered with scars and drooling uncontrollably.

qa.a: "I's a great craftsman, I is. Me shop is 'uge!" "You'll hafta be more specific: @arms or @armor?"
"What, you gone daft?" "I already made ya one!"
"@Gherick."
"Are ya learnin' how ta speak or do ya need somethin'?"
"I makes the most @hideous weapons!"
"You ain't the sort what'd be interested." "I ain't gonna tell you, you'd steal me brilliant ideas!" "I got some other stuff you could @buy, though."
"She's got the best food in the land. Go see for yerself."
"A fine warrior. New to this area."
"Shut the door on yer way out," he snarls.
He doesn't hear you. He hears you but doesn't respond.
He holds up a beautiful golden shield that glows softly. "Here ya go. Just as promised."
"What else can I get ya?"
"What's this? You can't carry no $1, $Y!"

153.name: Shubin
153.look: a man with a wide bottom. His voice is almost like a woman's.
153.hello: "Ooh, you look so thin! Here, have a bite of bread." He gives you a @roll; it is still warm from the oven. "Why, hello there, $G."

qa.a: "My name is Shubin, $G."
"I'm a @cook, $G."
"He is my friend."
"@Sandy says the mantra of eating is 'yum,' $G. Hee, hee!" You friend Iolo rolls his eyes. "Such wisdom we can surely do without!"
"I have no more rolls, $G."
"Being a cook is like being an @adventurer, $G."
"Yes, $G. I must gather up all my ingredients with @care."
"So that I have the right @ingredients, $G."
"Adventurers are always searching for this or that, $G. So are cooks." "Do you know of Magincian Pastry?"
"Have you one with you?"
"Goodbye, $G."
"That's one of the eight @mantras, isn't it?"
"Oh, do not tease old Shubin so, $G!"
"Oh, thank you, thank you, thank you!"

154.name: Amanda
154.look: a large black woman with a loud laugh.
154.hello: "Hello, hello!" she cries, clapping her hands together.* "You're here again! Good." She smiles widely. "What can I get ya?"

qa.a: "Amanda, but you can call me 'Miss Mandy'."
"Which, @ale, @mead, @wine, @rations or @Waybread?"
"I sell @ale, @mead, @wine, @rations and @Waybread."
"Please, call me 'Miss Mandy'."
"There, that's much better."
"He's been in here a few times. He has a homesick look, he does."
"Remember to tell your friends 'bout Miss Mandy."
"That's one on me. 'Tain't never heard o' that."
"Come back when you have some gold."
"Come back when you have some gold."
"That'll put some meat on your bones."

155.name: Caradon
155.look: a paladin with a longsword on his back.

qa.a: "I am pleased to hear that. I wish I were healthy again.
"I see. I would that I were healthy again, too.
"Sir Caradon of Trinsic, at thy service."
"I am a knight. Currently, though, I am recovering from a @battle."
"I've just come home from fighting in Yew. I fought gargoyles near the @shrine."

"There I was, with ten companions. Outside the Shrine of Honesty stood two gargoyles." "I saw them drink from little vials right before they charged us." "Large, clumsy brutes they were. They should have been easy to dispatch..." "But they fought like cyclones!" * "My captain ordered me to go to town for help when only we two and the gargoyles were left standing." "Just as I was returning with some guards, I saw the monsters throwing my friends' dead bodies onto a fire." "Then the gargoyles looked up at us and fell over, both @dead."
"Yes, just like that: all of a sudden!" * "I only wish I could have killed them myself, for @vengeance!"
"If they had not burned his body, my captain might have been resurrected." For a moment, Caradon looks ready to weep. "The @beasts!"
"Monsters with eyes like coals and skin like rock."
"Farewell, $G."

156.name: Morchella
156.look: a tough-looking woman with a walk like a troll.

qa.a: "I'm Morchella."
"I be a retired @sailor, that I am. " "Thou wert a @pirate!" "Well! How rude!" She turns up her nose and leaves.
"I know nothing about that!" She walks off in a huff.
"That's right, me bucko. Why, I've sailed with Lord @British and Captain @John.
"He walks with a limp, ye know. 'Fraid of mice, too, he is."
"He offered to marry me but of course I refused. Didn't want to be tied down."

She looks around furtively first. "Well, now, I might have seen the likes of that in me travels..." "Tell ye what, matey:" "If ye give me a @shield of the Order of the Serpent, I'll tell ye where that map be at."
"I might even ask 'im to marry me." She winks slyly at you.
"So long, matey."
"Don't know what to say 'bout that, matey."
"Then leave me be!" She turns her back angrily on you and walks off.

157.name: de Hugh
157.look: a commanding presence: a tall warrior in black armor.
157.hello: He stands and bows to you. "`$G. Art thou a warrior?"

qa.a: "Then why hast thou come to Serpent's Hold?"
"Good! I seek @courageous warriors to accompany me."
"Who wants to know?" "Well, `$Z, I am Baron de Hugh."
"I am a @mercenary now."
"First I shall gather an @army."
"I plan to build my reputation as a great fighter." * "My army and I will kill the mighty daemon @Sin'Vraal!"
"He is a malevolent creature, lord over numerous servants who crawl about the @desert."
"It is on the north-eastern tip of Britannia. Look it up on a map."
"It is foolish to be courageous unless one is backed by a well-trained force of fighters." "Or unless one happens to be the @Avatar, I imagine."
"I heard at the @guild that the Avatar was in town!"
"@Koronada says I will be considered for membership when I have done something noteworthy." "Have ye ever done aught worthy of note?"
"He is firm but fair. He does not wish to see any unworthy person bear the Silver Serpent @blazon."
"I believe the silver serpent is a quick and highly venomous creature."
"A blazon is a shield marking, such as a @serpent."
"Good luck, $G."
"That I cannot help ye with."

158.name: Loubet
158.hello: He greets you with an elaborate bow and flourish. "Good $T, mon ami e !" "'Ave you come to moi for @instruction?"

qa.a: "You 'ave but to ask, mah friend."

Loubet hands you a foil and a mask of golden mesh. He shows you the correct stance, then you spar for a bit. "Now ze off hand, $G... Mon dieu, you are (how you say it?) ambidextrous! Very good, mah friend." M'sieur Loubet is a skilled teacher, and you feel like you've really learned something.
"But no! You are too skilled, I 'ave nothing more to teach you!"

"Oui, I teach ze fencing here in my salle, my school." ." "Is very difficult sometimes. Most fighters, zey have no subtlety, no finesse." He turns up his nose and sniffs aristocratically. "Zey are not like you, mah friend! You are most talented!"
"I am M'sieur Loubet. " "@Touche!" He wields his foil casually, lunging at an imaginary target. " But you already know who I am, silly person!"
"Zat simply means 'touch.' In fencing we score by touching ze opponent with ze foil @tip."

"Zey are blunt on ze end, see?" "Ze first third of ze blade (near ze 'andle) is 'forte'--strong. It is good to parry with zis part of ze sword." "Ze rest of ze blade is 'foible'--weak and flexible." "Ze foil, she is a very delicate thing. There must be much skill, yes?" "You must 'old ze sword like a living bird:" "Too loose and she flies away. Too tight and she smothers. Just right, and..." "She sings very sweet!" He strikes metal and the foil makes a pleasant @ringing noise.
SHINGGG!
"I am ze @fencing @instructor."
"Au revoir!"
"I cannot 'elp you with zat."

159.name: Koranada
159.look: a dignified man wearing a loose jacket decorated with a serpent.
159.hello: "It is good to see thee again, $P." "Hello, adventurer s !" "As guildmaster, I welcome thee in the name of the Order of the Silver Serpent." "What is thy name?"

qa.a: "I am Koranada, son of Kulebra." "My father was a brave @lighthouse keeper."
"An earthquake destroyed the lighthouse, else I would have inherited the position of keeper in Greyhaven." "I traveled to Serpent's Hold to join the @Order instead."
"We stand for the principle of @Courage." "We are honored by thy membership, worthy Avatar!"
"Go and speak to de Hugh. Observe what he believes to be courage." "Though he is a fine fighter, he has yet to prove himself worthy of our @order."
"The Serpent Shield of our order is a sacred symbol of our brotherhood of bravery." "Carry it with pride!"
"'Tis secret, as well."
"You will most likely find him at Siege Crafters."
"I have responsibilities here ,$G. But I am honored by the offer."
"Without the meaning, such a symbol is just a meaningless scratching." "We @meditate on valour here."
"A mantra is a concept, a special word to be turned over and over in the mind." "When we meditate on a mantra, we do so in order to find the @meaning of that virtue."
"It is not enough just to know a mantra or possess a rune." "In order to be @virtuous, one must act virtuously."

"Sometimes one virtue conflicts with another, though both be numbered amongst the virtues of the Avatar." "The hero seeks to act with an awareness of these conflicts instead of merely following instinct." "My teacher @Conor taught me this."
"A dear friend. He was guildmaster here when I was in training." "He lives humbly in New Magincia now."
"Fare thee well."
"That I cannot help thee with."
"There will always be a place here for thee, $G."

"We would be greatly honored if thou wouldst join us, Avatar." "Thy deeds speak well of thee, $P." "I shall waive the usual requirements since thy adventures are more than sufficient proof of thy courage." "However, thou must still create thine own shield."

160.name: Simon
160.look: a muscular knight. He speaks in a raspy voice.
160.hello: "Good $T, $G." "Greetings, $G Avatar!" "Thou art most welcome in my castle, Avatar." He bows deeply to you.

qa.a: "Call me Simon, $G."
"I am the lord of Serpent's Hold."
"I personally favor the mantra of Valour." "I taught it to the bard @Culham in a song."
"He spends much time in Jhelom, though he be a @traveling bard."
"Yes, there's no telling where one might find him." "As I said, though, Jhelom is a good guess."

"If I had a rune, I'd wear it proudly." "But others fear for the safety of such important talismans, hiding them in some peculiar places." "I wonder if 'tis considered theft to seize a rune laid out for all to see..."
"Goodbye. I hope thou wilt visit me again when thou hast time, friend."
"I wish I could help thee with that, Avatar."

161.name: Tessa
161.hello: "Welcome again to Serpent's Hold, Avatar!" "Ah, $G $P! A sailor from Britain said thou had returned to the land!" "How glad I am to see that it is true!"

qa.a: "I'm Tessa. We met during thy last quest, Avatar!" "Strange that thou didst not recognize me." "I would have hoped that the past years had not taken that much toll on me!"
"I'm the keeper of the Flame of @Courage." "I also help my husband @Simon run this town." "How fortunate we were to come here after the @earthquake!"
"He is the lord of this hold."
You'll find many courageous fighters here!"

"After thy last quest, there were many great earthquakes." "The island of Bordermarch sank into the sea, along with our keep!" "Only through great fortune did Simon and I make it off the island alive!"
"Farewell, Avatar! Be brave in thy quest!"
"Pardon?"

162.name: Seggallion
162.look: a huge, muscled warrior with a sad look in his eyes.
162.hello: He looks at you imploringly. "What is it?"

qa.a: "Seggallion of...well now that won't mean anything to you."
"If you mean my profession, I would have to say a knight of @Ashtalarea."
"A land @unfamiliar to you, I'm sure. Just as unfamiliar as yours is to me."
"Yes, I was walking in the mountains of @Tyme when suddenly I heard a noise." "It was dark and I heard this low growling." "Having just been released from @Pildar's clutches, I was tired and hungry."
"That is a great range of mountains in my land. Wherever that is now."
"From what I hear, he is not unlike your Mondain." "Anyway, I peered into the darkness but could see nothing." "Suddenly a huge wall of @blue flame appeared behind me."
"Yes, blue like nothing I had seen in any spell." "Anyway, just as I turned, the creature leapt from the woods." "It hit me with such force, we both @entered the blue flame together."
"Well, it didn't burn us, we just fell through to the ground beyond it." "After struggling for a while, I finally managed to kill it." "That's when I wandered into this @community."
"The people of this land are brave and honorable." "They fed and clothed me when I discovered that my gold was not the same as yours." "I know it is a @queer story, but true none the less."

"Yes it is. Still, if I could I would like to join you on your quest." "Perhaps one of the people in your land will know how to get me back to mine." "If not, at least I can thank your people by assisting you."
"Farewell."
"That's one on me. 'Tain't never heard o' that."
"Farewell."

163.name: Finn
163.look: a sly looking fellow, dressed in rags.

qa.a: He glances around quickly, to see if anyone seems to be listening. "I'm Lord British. But don't tell anyone." * "I'm in @disguise so I can mingle with the @commoners."
"I'm pretending to be a @beggar. That way nobody will suspect who I really am. Here, give me a few coins to keep anyone from getting suspicious."
"Of course, nobody would dare say anything bad about me to my face. Nobody except @Chuckles, anyway." * "But as a beggar, people will tell me just about anything!"
"He's in disguise too, you know. He's really @Blackthorn."
"I decided banishment was too harsh for him, so I brought him back and made him my jester." * "The real Chuckles is tied up in my @dungeons. I got tired of him making fun of my nose."
"I'm Lord British, and I can do whatever I want to!"
"Very convincing, don't you think? I made it myself."
"I've got forty million crowns. Not to mention my secret bank @accounts."
"I told you not to mention that!"
"I'm really Lord British. I can prove it to you. I know all of the @eight @mantras, and where the @runes are, too!"
"I killed a @dragon when I was eight, you know. With my bare hands, too!"
"He was a big one - but he hadn't reckoned with the likes of me. I was a @tough kid."
"I was so tough he couldn't chew me, and he had to spit me out. That's when I killed him."

"Ok, here are the mantras: justice - do compassion - re honor - mi valour - fa spirituality - so humility - la sacrifice - ti Gosh, wouldn't you know it? The Mantra of Honesty slips my mind at the moment..."

"I'll tell you this, because you look like someone who can keep a secret." * "I sent out eight fake runes to all the lords, to fool everybody." * "I put all the real ones in a little box, and hid it under my throne." * "You can't see it there, because I turned it @invisible!"
"A clever trick, or my I'm not @Finn!"
"Oh, that's just the name I'm pretending to go by. Of course you know I'm really Lord British." * "I can see you're too smart to be fooled by this disguise."

"If you need me later, I'll be at the Blue Boar, disguised as the tavernkeeper." * "But I won't admit to it there if you ask me... Too many people that might hear." You see Shamino smiling - an unusual sight. * Noticing your attention, he says "Perhaps there's a little of Lord British in us all."
"Oh, I know all about that. But I think you'd be better off if you learned about it on your own."
"Broke, are you? Well, come by after I'm done with this disguise,* and I'll give you a loan from the royal @treasury."

164.name: Beh Lem
164.hello: "To ask how I can help, mighty $P," Beh Lem asks. The gargoyle greets you enthusiastically, but you can't understand him! Seeing your confusion, he switches to the human language. It's obviously a strain for him. "Hello. I little human @speak." $Y speaks. "$P, let's away from here." "There's naught of use this creature can tell us. Agreed?"

qa.a: The confused gargoyle waves good-bye.
"As you wish, $G."
"Captain John friend. He come here. I wait here."
"No name. I Beh Lem."
"I wait here. @Captain John come."
"@Captain John teach I human speak," the gargoyle says haltingly.
The confused gargoyle waves good-bye.
The gargoyle shrugs.
"To know Captain John! To help him and @Valkedesh in their work," the youngster says proudly.
"To not receive a true name until I have proved myself @worthy."
"To not deserve a name yet. But to get one someday, just like my father @Valkadesh!"
"To very much respect Valkadesh my father." "To want to be a scholar someday just like him!"
"To ask what directions were unclear?"
"To not know much about that. But to be sure that @Valkadesh would know!"
"To be one of our guiding @principles."
"To be surprised that you don't know that!" "To have three guiding principles - @control, @diligence, and @passion." "To be the basis of all gargoyle beliefs."
"To be feared by everybody - everybody except me and @Valkadesh, my father!"
"To wish to stay with you!" * "To not leave until there is peace between our races!"
"To be in danger from the lava! To stay far away!"
"To walk clockwise around the mountains from Hythloth to reach my father's @house."
"To find the house of Valkadesh my father through the pass east of the @Hall."
"To find the Hall of Knowledge to the south of the city." "To avoid the Hall! To talk to @Valkadesh first!"
"Good! To know that he very much wanted to speak with you."

165.name: Bolesh
165.look: a strong, winged gargoyle warrior. He is sorely wounded.
165.hello: The gargoyle struggles to sit up. He shouts, "An-bal-sil-fer! Agra-lem! Agra-lem!" The gargoyle collapses, exhausted. The gargoyle struggles to sit up. He shouts, "The False Prophet! Guards! Guards!" The gargoyle collapses, outraged but exhausted. The gargoyle struggles to sit up. "The False Prophet!" "But to wear the Amulet of Submission?" "Then to express awe at your honor and courage." "Greetings again, honored one."

qa.a: "To be named Bolesh Us-agra-lem, Bolesh the Troop-@Leader."
"To lead what remains of our forces into battle." "To have recently returned from a mission to your side of the world." "To have tried to reach the @Codex."
"To have had victory between our claws, but to have been thwarted on the verge of success!" "To have encountered an impervious @force field around the Codex."
"To know that such a field surrounded the Codex when my people possessed it." "To remember that only those on sacred @quests for wisdom could pass."
"To receive a sacred quest at the @Temple of Singularity." "But to be uncertain whether a human's request would be answered there."
"To find the temple in the mountains to the north." "To need to fly to get there, though!"
"Yes, to be accessible only to the superior winged gargoyles." "To be totally unreachable by land-bound worker gargoyles!" "To suppose that it is totally unreachable by land-bound humans as well."
"Farewell, False Prophet." "To honor my people with your sacrifice."
Weakly, the gargoyle says, "What?"

166.name: Caretaker
166.look: an old, winged gargoyle. An odd device crafted of glass and metal rests upon his face.
166.hello: The gargoyle ignores you and continues writing. "Yes? To inquire about the reason for yet another this interruption."

qa.a: "To suppose that you are making a joke." "To know as well as you that you took the Codex to your side of the world!"
"To not be a signpost!" "To find the Temple of Singularity in the mountains to the north - if you can @fly!"

"To be unable to reach the mountain-locked Temple of Singularity on foot." "To only be able to reach that holy place if you are a winged gargoyle." "To find this most fitting and proper." "To see no reason to let human riff-raff into the Temple."
"To find what you seek in the @Vortex Chamber."
"To find what you seek in the @Librum Chamber."

"To regret that that item is lost, stolen by human thieves years ago." "To have heard the humans mention the name @Stonegate as they fled." "To have heard them say they would sail through Lost Hope Bay." "To know nothing more about its whereabouts."
"To admit ignorance regarding the location of the moonstones."
"To suspect it to be someplace in the human-filled Underworld."
"To be called the Caretaker, in lieu of a name." "To be honored by being allowed to perform my @duties as caretaker of this @Hall."
"To care for my race's artifacts that rest here in the @Hall of Knowledge."
"To keep the treasured artifacts of our race here in this Hall, in the three @chambers."

"To have three rooms here:" "To keep artifacts from the @Underworld in the Human Chamber, to the east." "To keep valuable books in the Librum Chamber, to the west." "And to keep the @Cube and the @Lens in the Vortex Chamber, to the south."
"Yes, the Underworld. To believe you know it as 'Britannia.'"
Without another word, the gargoyle returns to his work.
"To lack any time for idle chatter." "To desire you to get to the point and then depart."

167.name: Draxinusom
167.look: a large, winged gargoyle of regal bearing.
167.hello: The gargoyle screams, "An-bal-sil-fer! Klep lem! Por-aylem ter-ort ka!" "To be honored by your presence, noble $P. To feel sorrow that matters of state prevent conversation." "To summon you when proper time for your sacrifice has come." "To refrain from slaying you only because of the presence of the child, False Prophet!" "To demand to know why you have returned here, False Prophet!" "To express astonishment at your audacity, False Prophet!"

qa.a: "To be named Draxinusom, leader of our race." "To demand to know why you have come before me!"
"To be the leader of our race. To have little time to waste chatting with the False Prophet!"
"Flee, False Prophet! To seize you for sacrifice the instant my army returns from the Underworld!"

The gargoyle shows you a crystal amulet dangling from a leather cord. "Hsss....To consent to wear this?" Trusted Dupre whispers frantically to you, "You mustn't! It's some sort of magical trap!" The gargoyle waits impatiently for an answer. "Yes or no, False Prophet?"
"To be necessary for surrender! To ask again for your acceptance of this." Your answer:
The gargoyle hands you the amulet, and you slip the leather loop over your head.
"To be willing to die to save my people?"

168.name: Naxatilor
168.hello: The venerable gargoyle does not acknowledge your presence. "To have nothing to say to you, False Prophet!" "To greet you again, $P." "To greet you, $P, Avatar of the Underworld." "To see the Amulet of Submission around your neck." "To consider your acceptance of this both noble and wise." "To observe by your aura that such honorable deeds are rare for you." "To not be surprised, then, that you are @fated to destroy a world." "To observe by your aura that you are not a being of evil." "To regret for your sake, then, that you are @fated to destroy a world." "To observe by your aura that you are

qa.a: "To have spoken to Scholar Valkadesh?" "Then surely to know what harm you have caused my world!" "To have no @choice but to return the Codex!"
"To have wreaked great havoc in this land by your theft of the Codex!" "To have no @choice but to return it!"
"To see only two alternatives: to return the @Codex, or to give up your life."
"Hss...Yes, to know of the three meanings of that word." "To ask to which type of sacrifice you refer: @self, @others or items of @value?"
"To admire your willingness to sacrifice your life for the good of my people." "But to doubt that that is the meaning of the prophecy."

"What?!" "To suggest that you can atone for your misdeed by bathing in the blood of others?!" "To find such thoughts well in keeping with the blackness of your aura!" "To find such thoughts unworthy of your honorable aura!"
"To know of only one item of true value--the Codex itself." "Surely not to destroy the Codex!?"
"To direct you to go to the Hall of Knowledge, south of here." "There to read the Book of Ritual." "There also to get the Vortex Lens!" "Then to return here, where I will tell you what must be done!"
"To be able to see the @Vortex from both sides of the world!" "To benefit both races equally if the Codex is @returned there!"
"To be called Naxatilor."
"To be a seer, mystic advisor to my people." "But to be unable to avert what is written in the Book of Prophecies."
"To be sure to show the human lensmaker the Vortex Lens." "Also to be sure to tell the human lensmaker that his lens must be concave!" "To be most important--concave!"
"To know not where the Codex is." "But to remember that Captain Bolesh just returned from the Codex!" "To suggest you seek him. To try the healer's house to the north."
